hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *results/*|*.duckdb) echo "{\"decision\":\"block\",\"reason\":\"Refusing to edit $f directly. Files under results/ and *.duckdb are produced by 'bi-evals run' and 'bi-evals ingest'. If a test is failing, fix the underlying code or golden — do not hand-edit the artifact.\"}"; exit 0 ;; esac; }
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.py) cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && uv run ruff format "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */src/bi_evals/config.py|*/src/bi_evals/cli.py|*/src/bi_evals/scorer/dimensions.py|*/src/bi_evals/scorer/entry.py|*/golden/*.yaml) echo "{\"hookSpecificOutput\":{\"hookEventName\":\"PostToolUse\",\"additionalContext\":\"You edited $f, which is user-facing. Per CLAUDE.md, also update tmp/my-evals/ if this change affects config schema, CLI surface, scoring behavior, or golden-test format. If unsure, ask the user.\"}}" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
